title: Adobe CEO Shantanu Narayen will step down after a successor is named; he became CEO in 2007 and will remain as chair of the board; ADBE drops 6%+ after hours (CNBC)
summary: CNBC: Adobe CEO Shantanu Narayen will step down after a successor is named; he became CEO in 2007 and will remain as chair of the board; ADBE drops 6%+ after hours — Adobe said CEO Shantanu Narayen will step down as CEO after a successor has been named, and remain as chair of the design software company's board.
